title: 第二十四章 阐门十二散手第二十五章 恶驼铃和护道妻
lines: 将道祖太极鱼研究了很久，李唯一觉得这是克制白骨妖魔最重要的法宝，因此使用各种方法去激活。
先用几滴他自己的血，又用金乌和黑蛟的血，但都没有反应。
将右足足心诞生出来的滚烫气流注入，更是石沉大海。
“要激活它，肯定跟我的血液有关，而且每一次都是非常危险的时候。难道遭遇生命危险的时候，我体内的血液会变得不一样？”
除此之外，似乎需要的血液还非常之多。
血液越多，它的动静越强烈，越持久。
一切都是猜测和分析……
李唯一咬了咬牙，决定做一件蠢事。于是，用剑将手腕割破，去浸润道祖太极鱼，放了接近半碗，却一点反应都没有。
“算了，算了……还是等以后遭遇生死危险，再尝试。”
李唯一连忙调动右足足心的滚烫气流止血疗伤，将手腕裹缠起来。随后，端起桌上的一杯稀释了的金乌血喝下，以补充血气。
双手捏“子午太极印”，行玉虚呼吸法，调动右足足心涌出的滚烫气流，在十三条银色痕脉中运转，以炼化金乌血蕴含的灼热秘能。
最近几天，他每天都在饮金乌血，肉身力量增长显著。
半个小时后，李唯一停下。
“肉身好像没什么变化……之前喝下金乌血，全身都在发热，心跳和血流速度会加快不少。”
“再喝一杯试试。”
几天前，喝下第一杯金乌血后，李唯一就对它失去敬畏。
因为他体内那股滚烫气流，可以将之炼化，甚至都不用佩戴十字项坠在身。
蔡羽彤只是喝下一杯，就差点被焚身而死。幸好有十字项坠，她身体剧烈变化，蜕变如似仙灵。
李唯一前前后后喝下已有十杯，但没有出现焚身迹象，也没有脱壳蜕变，只是肉身力量增强了而已。
他也不知道该郁闷，还是该庆幸。
第十一杯喝下后，只感金乌血淡如水，身体毫无反应。
“我肉身应该又达到了一个临界点，需要某种突破，才能更进一步。”
怎么才能突破呢？
稀释的金乌血淡了，没有稀释的呢？能不能带来足够强烈的刺激？
只凭外物，有机会冲破临界点吗？
说干就干。
现在还能拼一把。
总不能等白骨妖魔先来收拾他，那样就只能等死。
李唯一将一杯没有稀释的金乌血喝下，入腹后，越来越滚烫，就像将岩浆装进了身体。立即行玉虚呼吸法，调动右足足心的滚烫气流炼化。
十三条银色痕脉根本炼化不过来，金乌血似要将他五脏六腑烧穿。
全身冒烟雾，血液像在沸腾。
嘴里像能喷出火。
“没那么可怕，还扛得住。”
李唯一右足足心的泉眼，喷涌得越来越强烈，与金乌血激烈对抗。
蓦地。
一股冰冷刺骨的寒气，从左足足心冒出。

After studying the Taozu Taichi Fish for a long time, Li Weiwei felt that it was the most important magic weapon to restrain the Bone Demon, so he used various methods to activate it.
First he used a few drops of his own blood, and then the blood of the Golden Crow and the Black Dragon, but there was no reaction.
Injecting the hot air that was born from the center of the right foot, it was nothing more than nothing.
"To activate it, it must have something to do with my blood, and every time it is a very dangerous time. Could it be that when my life is in danger, the blood in my body will become different?"
In addition, it seems that a lot of blood is needed.
The more blood there is, the stronger and more lasting its movement is.
It’s all speculation and analysis…
Li Weiyi gritted his teeth and decided to do something stupid. So, he cut his wrist with a sword and soaked the Taozu Taichi fish. He put nearly half a bowl in, but there was no reaction at all.
"Forget it, forget it... let's wait until we encounter life and death danger in the future before trying again."
Li Weiwei quickly mobilized the hot air flow from the sole of his right foot to stop the bleeding and heal the injury, and wrapped his wrist. Then, he picked up a cup of diluted Golden Crow blood on the table and drank it to replenish his blood.
Hold the "Ziwu Tai Chi Seal" with both hands, perform the Yuxu Breathing Method, and mobilize the hot air flow from the center of the right foot to circulate in the thirteen silver trace veins to refine the scorching secret energy contained in the Golden Crow Blood.
In recent days, he has been drinking Golden Crow blood every day, and his physical strength has increased significantly.
Half an hour later, Li Weiwei stopped.
"There seems to be no change in the physical body... After drinking Golden Crow blood before, my whole body was heating up, and my heartbeat and blood flow speed would speed up a lot."
"Try another drink."
A few days ago, after drinking the first glass of Golden Crow blood, Li Weiwei lost awe of it.
Because the hot air current in his body can refine it, he doesn't even need to wear a cross pendant.
Cai Yutong was almost burned to death after just one drink. Fortunately, she had the cross pendant, and her body changed drastically, transforming like a fairy.
Li Weiwei drank ten cups in succession, but he showed no signs of being burned, nor did he shed his shell and transform, but his physical strength only increased.
He didn't know whether to be depressed or grateful.
After drinking the eleventh cup, I only felt that the Golden Crow blood was as light as water, and my body showed no reaction.
"My body must have reached a critical point again, and I need some kind of breakthrough before I can go further."
How can we break through?
The diluted Golden Crow blood is weak, but what about the undiluted one? Can it bring a strong enough stimulation?
Is there any chance of breaking through the critical point with only external objects?
Just do it.
You can still give it a try now.
You can't wait for the Bone Demon to deal with him first, otherwise you will have to wait for death.
Li Weiwei drank a cup of undiluted Golden Crow blood. After entering his stomach, it became hotter and hotter, as if magma had been filled into his body. Immediately perform the Yuxu breathing method and mobilize the hot air flow in the center of your right foot to refine it.
The thirteen silver trace veins couldn't be refined at all, and the Golden Crow blood seemed to burn through his internal organs.
Smoke was rising all over his body, and his blood seemed to be boiling.
It looks like fire can come out of its mouth.
"It's not that scary. It's still bearable."
The spring in the heart of Li Weiwei's right foot was gushing more and more intensely, fighting fiercely with the Golden Crow blood.
Suddenly.
"Wow!"
A biting cold air came out from the center of his left foot.
